highlight.text: Bring this version of Court booking back?
highlight.note: A restore adds a version; nothing in the history is lost.

highlight.text: It becomes the newest version, made by you
highlight.note: Court booking is shared. Had it been public, this would add that it becomes private.
“Keep the live version”, or Escape, cancels.

highlight.none: “Bringing it back” shows only while the version is restored, which is over before a ring could be drawn; the next step rings the version it leaves.

steps.note: It becomes the newest version, then it is rebuilt and restarted.

highlight.note: A new version, made by Lena, is live now.

highlight.text: The earlier version is back and running.
It is public now, so it becomes private
highlight.note: Look at the restored version before making it public again.

highlight.text: It was public, so it is private now.
highlight.note: Only a person makes it public again.

highlight.text: The earlier version is back, but it is not running yet.
highlight.note: The restore stands; rebuild it below (APP-15).

variations.title: A Viewer cannot bring one back

highlight.note: A Viewer reads the history; a Builder brings a version back.
